desc: [0602 InArm watchdog] 檔案層 watchdog 計時器與逾時常數：DoInArmLoadStageNoTray_Watchdog(30s) / DoInArmLoadStageEmptyTray_Watchdog(60s) (matrix ainarm9045.cpp:7057,7060)
[0602 InArm watchdog] DoInArmPickFromLoadStage_9045 函式內兩個 static latch（arm once，避免每次掃描重啟計時）(matrix ainarm9045.cpp:7080,7082)
[0602 InArm watchdog] case 10：真的有 IC 可取 -> 解除 empty-tray watchdog (matrix ainarm9045.cpp:7172)。取代 V910[7720,7722] 以取得唯一錨點，兩端上下文位元組相同

[0602 InArm watchdog + 0803 CC_ARDENTEC 閘門] case 15 有盤分支：解除 no-tray watchdog、殘留空盤 watchdog（60s -> WAR09101/K_RETRY），整段以 CosFunction.bUseInArmLoadStageWatchdog 閘控 (matrix ainarm9045.cpp:7260,7262 + 20260803:7263)
[0602 InArm watchdog] case 15 無盤分支：真的空站 -> 解除 empty-tray watchdog；auto-skip 成立 -> 解除 no-tray watchdog (matrix ainarm9045.cpp:7283,7287)

[0602 InArm watchdog + 0803 CC_ARDENTEC 閘門] case 15 無盤且無 auto-skip：新增 else 區塊，30s no-tray watchdog -> WAR09101/K_RETRY，整段以 CosFunction.bUseInArmLoadStageWatchdog 閘控 (matrix ainarm9045.cpp:7298 + 20260803:7299)
[0602 TrayArm 配套] DoCatchTray case 145 殘料檢查 pass 後改走 Task=148（LoaderY 歸位中間步驟），不再直接 Task=100 (matrix acatchtray.cpp:5915)

[0602 TrayArm 配套] 新增 case 148：台車模式(INSTALL_OCR_YMot==eocrYMotInstal)先退 C_LoaderUpPress、MLoaderY 回 Prod.iMLoaderYSurePos、放開 C_TrayY_Fixer/C_LoaderEdgePush，再回 Task=100；否則直接 Task=100 (matrix acatchtray.cpp:5948,5949)
[0803 CC_ARDENTEC 閘門] HT9045_COUSTOMER_FUNCTION 新增 bUseInArmLoadStageWatchdog 成員宣告，位置比照 V899 緊接 bCleanCountAlarmByMin (matrix CosFunction.h:470)

[0803 CC_ARDENTEC 閘門] FUNC_CC_ARDENTEC() 開啟 bUseInArmLoadStageWatchdog=true (matrix CosFunction.cpp:2789)。注意：V910 此函式為空殼，只補這一行，V899 另外三行(bTrayDeviceCheckFromLoader/bTrayOCR/bFTPFunction)不在本波矩陣範圍故不搬。錨點僅為 '{'，安全網見 OP11 說明

[0803 CC_ARDENTEC 閘門] InitialCosFunction 預設 bUseInArmLoadStageWatchdog=false（其他客戶維持 V910 原行為）(matrix CosFunction.cpp:4414)。本 op 行號較大故 splice.py 先跑；若 CosFunction.cpp 曾被其他波位移，本 op 錨點必失敗並整檔中止，等於保護了 OP10 的弱錨點
